title.zh: Crypto Groups Push SEC for Tailored Rules on Novel ETFs
title.en: Crypto Groups Push SEC for Tailored Rules on Novel ETFs

current_state.zh: Crypto groups and financial firms are urging the SEC to adopt tailored rules for novel exchange-traded products beyond traditional ETFs, covering crypto, private assets, event contracts, and leveraged strategies.
